hero.title: Glucose alerts that reach you before it's urgent.
hero.body: Connect your own Dexcom Share account and get WhatsApp alerts the moment glucose leaves the safe range, plus phone call escalation for lows -- so nothing gets missed.
hero.traceCaption: Example trace across a safe, high, and low reading

trustStrip.trial: 7-day free trial, no card charged until day 8
trustStrip.credentials: Your Dexcom credentials, encrypted and never shared

steps.body1: Enter your Dexcom Share login once. Readings start flowing in under a minute.
steps.body2: Choose the safe range and critical cutoffs for each person, in mg/dL.
steps.body3: Messages arrive at the pace the number calls for: none in range, every five minutes in a low or high, every minute when it's critical.

features.scaleBody: The message rate follows how far outside the safe range a reading is.
features.setupBody: Connect your own Dexcom Share login, add up to two alert contacts, and set your ranges -- no phone calls to a support line required.
features.reportsBody: See when spikes and lows tend to happen, so patterns are easy to spot and discuss.

safety.title: Information, not instructions.
safety.body: Glucoalarm logs carb counts and insulin doses, and can show the math for a correction factor you enter yourself, as prescribed by your doctor. It does not calculate or suggest insulin doses. Dosing decisions stay with you and your care team.

login.quote: Nothing gets missed. That's all we set out to build.
login.tagline: Glucoalarm, glucose alerts that reach you before it's urgent
login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Enter your account details.
login.errorUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.

signup.title: Start your 7-day free trial
signup.subtitle: One flat monthly price after the trial. Connect your own Dexcom Share account, add up to two phone numbers, and start receiving WhatsApp alerts and low-glucose phone calls within minutes.
signup.trialNote: First 7 days free. Your card is charged starting day 8, then monthly until you cancel.
signup.feature1: One monitored person, connected via Dexcom Share
signup.feature2: WhatsApp alerts for lows, highs, and safe-range check-ins
signup.feature3: Low-glucose phone call escalation, up to two contacts
signup.disclaimer: Glucoalarm is a notification tool, not a medical device. It does not calculate or suggest insulin doses. After checkout, you'll set up your account and connect Dexcom in a few short steps. See our <refundPolicy>refund policy</refundPolicy> and <terms>terms</terms>.

onboarding.title: Set up Glucoalarm
onboarding.missingSession: Missing checkout session. <login>Log in</login> to resume a signup already in progress, or start over from <signup>signup</signup>.

account.intro: Payment confirmed. Set up your account to continue.

accountGoogle.intro: Payment confirmed. Signed in with Google -- just name your account to continue.

dexcom.intro: Connect the Dexcom Share account for the person being monitored. This is the same login used in the Dexcom mobile app -- Glucoalarm polls it the same way Dexcom Follow does.
dexcom.nameLabel: Name of the person being monitored
dexcom.errorAuth: Those Dexcom credentials didn't work. Double-check the username and password and try again.
dexcom.errorGeneric: Couldn't connect to Dexcom. Try again.

contacts.intro: Up to two phone numbers can receive alerts for this person -- nobody else.

thresholds.intro: Set your alert ranges in mg/dL, and how often you want a check-in message while glucose is in the safe range. You can change these anytime in Settings.
thresholds.criticalLowLabel: Critical low -- below this, phone calls repeat every 5 min until acknowledged
thresholds.errorOrder: Thresholds must satisfy: critical low < safe low < safe high < critical high
